description: This file defines the LogFragment class which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying log information using a custom LogView. It manages UI setup and updates to display log data, integrating with Android's lifecycle and view hierarchy.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that contains a LogView to display log messages. It inflates the view hierarchy programmatically, manages UI layout, and scrolls to the bottom when new log entries are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView instances, sets their layout parameters, padding, typeface, and other properties, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overridden lifecycle method that inflates the views by calling inflateViews(), sets up a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the LogView instance managed by the fragment.
